title: TestSIGTERMToALiveRunEvacuatesItsWorkToTheRemote fails at base, on this branch and on origin/epic/2jn: the SIGTERM exit leaves a registry-guard temp tree behind
description:
internal/cli/evacuate_signal_test.go:213 reports 'the SIGTERM exit left its temp trees behind: [ticfac-registry-guard-<n>]'. Independently reproduced in scratch worktrees at the pre-vqc base a999d400, at the vqc close commit 48abbf7f, and at origin/epic/2jn (98d68b8c), so it is not vqc's and not this attempt's — the close-out's full suite will hit it on the epic branch as it stands. It is an end-to-end test (skipped under -short), so `make gate` is green while `make test`/CI is red. The leftover name suggests the registry guard's temp root (learnings: 7ag, registrytest.GuardMain) is not released on the SIGTERM exit path. Dedup: same finding as attempt 50's, now with the epic-branch reproduction added.

ticfac run epic-2jn filed this backlog tick from the finding c8b050f14bb5a1a52b862a09cdc492c3545719af62518f34745d0265f6ef03f6 (reported by run-epic-2jn/tick-vqc/attempt-51): the done is reachable with the finding standing, so it is a backlog tick with an owner rather than the epic's to absorb. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-2jn/absorptions/c8b050f14bb5a1a52b862a09cdc492c3545719af62518f34745d0265f6ef03f6.json on the run branch.
